name: s75-stop-gate-non-ascii-path-blocks
notes: A failing file under a non-ASCII path, with an ASCII-only Python I/O encoding (PYTHONIOENCODING=ascii, or a Latin-1 locale). Printing the path raised UnicodeEncodeError in the stop-gate reader, whose failure was swallowed as 'nothing blocks'. The helper now does UTF-8 I/O, and any helper failure at stop blocks.
